heading: Israeli checkpoint leaves Qusra residents trapped, settlers move freely in ‘closed military zone’

heading: Yemeni forces target Houthi positions, destroy drone boats
body: Yemen’s military says it has carried out drone attacks against Iran-allied Houthi targets across several fronts, according to the army’s media centre.

heading: Former US National Security Adviser says US blockade of Iranian oil an ‘enormous win’
body: Former US National Security Adviser John Bolton has described the US blockade of Iranian oil as an “enormous win,” saying it is having a major impact on Iran’s economy and should remain in place.

heading: With UN peacekeepers gone, can Europe fill the gap in Lebanon?
body: With the nearly 50-year UN peacekeeping mandate in southern Lebanon set to expire at the end of 2026, proposals for a European Union mission to fill some part of the vacuum have attracted attention.

heading: Iran, China foreign ministers hold talks in Kyrgyzstan
body: Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has held talks with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on the sidelines of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, according to Tehran’s top diplomat’s Telegram channel.

heading: Iran says it’s clear US ‘stuck’ in Middle East quagmire
body: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei says mediation efforts by Pakistan and other countries are continuing.

heading: Qatar denounces Israeli ‘exploitation’ of Middle East crisis
body: Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson Majed al-Ansari has accused Israel of exploiting the conflict between the US and Iran to launch deadly strikes throughout the region.

heading: Iran says it will continue to resist US attacks and pressure
body: Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei is holding a press conference and denouncing US “ill intentions” against his country.

heading: WFP says funding shortages cut food assistance in occupied West Bank in half
body: The World Food Programme (WFP) says funding shortages are forcing it to cut its food assistance in the occupied West Bank in half as settler pogroms intensify and Israeli army operations continue.

heading: Hamas condemns Israeli attacks as continuation of ‘war of genocide’ against Palestinians
body: Hamas has condemned Israeli attacks on Gaza today that have killed at least five people and wounded numerous others, calling it a “systematic, fascist escalation by the government of war criminal [Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin] Netanyahu”.

heading: US CENTCOM says 84 vessels redirected during naval blockade
body: US Central Command (CENTCOM) says as of today, troops have redirected 84 commercial vessels during its ongoing naval blockade against Iran.

heading: Ghalibaf calls on public to conserve fuel amid US blockade
body: In an earlier video statement, Iran’s Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf addressed the country’s fuel situation amid the US’s naval blockade.

heading: Explosions heard in Iranian city of Asaluyeh, says governor
body: The governor of Asaluyeh reports that an explosion was heard in the city, Iran’s Fars reports.

heading: IRGC chief says ‘unparalleled coordination’ with army air defence forces
body: Major General Ahmad Vahidi says in a message to Brigadier General Alireza Elhami, commander of the Army’s Defence Force, that there was “unparalleled coordination” between the air defence forces of the armed forces and the IRGC, Fars reports.

heading: Dublin’s MEP criticises EU ‘inertia’ on Israel’s policies and illegal settlements in West Bank
body: Barry Andrews, a member of the European Parliament for Dublin, commented on the situation in the occupied West Bank in an interview with Al Jazeera.

heading: Iranian supreme leader says Tehran has ‘unforgettable lessons’ for US
body: “Dear Iran and the Resistance Front, it has unforgettable lessons for the American enemy”, Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei said in a post on X after US strikes on Iran began.

heading: IRGC claims ballistic missile attack on US military barracks in Jordan
body: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says it has carried out a ballistic attack targeting a US Marine Corps barracks at Camp Titin, a military site near the Gulf of Aqaba in Jordan.

heading: Iran’s IRGC claims ballistic missile strike on US drone hangars in Jordan
body: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) says it launched a “heavy” ballistic missile attack on Prince Hassan Air Base in Jordan, targeting hangars housing long-range RQ-4 and MQ-9 drones.

heading: Four killed in attack on wedding in Iran’s Sirik region
body: Reporting from Tehran, Iran

heading: Warning alert of ‘potential’ threat activated in Bahrain
body: The Ministry of Interior has urged citizens and residents to remain calm, proceed to the nearest safe location, and follow news through official channels for the protection of public safety.

heading: Iran says attacks on US forces to continue ‘until they regret their crimes’
body: Colonel Ebrahim Zolfaghari, spokesman for Iran’s Khatam al-Anbiya Central Headquarters, says Iranian forces have launched missile and drone attacks on US bases in the region in response to strikes on military and civilian sites in southern Iran, in a speech carried by state broadcaster IRIB.

heading: Regional escalation widens as Kuwait, Jordan, and Bahrain report incoming Iranian drones and missiles
body: Reporting from Doha, Qatar

heading: Iran’s IRGC claims missile, drone attack on US facilities in Iraq

heading: Israeli military says interception earlier likely a ‘false target’
body: The Israeli military has said that its interception overnight of a “suspicious aerial target” was “apparently launched at a false target”, it said, following an investigation.

heading: Bahrain denounces ‘heinous’ Iran attacks; pledges to defend kindgom
body: Bahrain has condemned “treacherous Iranian air attacks” saying its forces destroyed a number of incoming projectiles.

heading: WATCH: Moment US strikes on Iranian port city hit wedding party
body: Iran says a series of US strikes near its southern port city of Sirik has killed at least four people, including a child at a wedding party.

heading: ‘US is in a very confused state in terms of its strategic goals’
body: A security analyst has expressed “deep, deep concern” after the United States resumed attacks on Iran after a monthlong lull in the war.

heading: Iran’s Red Crescent calls ICC to investigate US strike on Kuhestak wedding ceremony
body: In a letter to the International Criminal Court, Iran’s Red Crescent Society (IRCS) has called for legal action following last night’s US missile strike on a wedding ceremony in Kuhestak, Hormozgan.

heading: Jordanians question value of US bases after repeated Iranian attacks
body: Reporting from Doha, Qatar

heading: Water wells, greenhouses destroyed by Israeli bulldozers in Hebron
body: Israeli forces have demolished four water wells and several greenhouses in the al-Thaghra neighbourhood of Beit Ummar, north of Hebron in the occupied West Bank.

heading: US deploying military and economic tactics to fight Iran
body: Reporting from Washington, DC

heading: What is Iran’s Castle Breaker missile, used against US bases?
body: Castle Breaker is a medium-range ballistic missile which has been developed by the IRGC as part of its wider range of missiles.

heading: UAE condemns ‘hostile’ Iranian attacks
body: The United Arab Emirates condemned “hostile attacks by Iran” that targeted Bahrain, Jordan and the semi-autonomous Kurdish region of Iraq.

heading: Iran blacklists 11 ships from sailing through Hormuz
body: Iran’s Persian Gulf Strait Authority (PGSA) has added a further 11 ships to its blacklist, barring the vessels from transiting through the Strait of Hormuz for “non-compliance”.

heading: Trump is ‘confused’ and ‘not happy’ with lack of clear victory in Iran

heading: Qatar’s Sheikh Mohammed speaks to Turkish, Lebanese FMs to discuss latest regional tensions
body: Qatari Foreign Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani spoke to his Turkish counterpart, Hakan Fidan, during a phone call, during which they reviewed “relations of cooperation between the two countries”.

heading: US CENTCOM says 86 vessels redirected in Strait of Hormuz
body: The US military’s Central Command (CENTCOM) says the Navy is continuing to enforce its blockade against Iran and has redirected 86 commercial vessels as of today – up from 84 yesterday.

heading: US secretary of state warns countries against aiding Iran, threatening sanctions
body: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned that any country helping Iran create “mechanisms” to generate funds will also face sanctions from Washington.

heading: Iran criticises UNICEF over lack of response to deaths of Iranian children
body: Iran’s representative to the United Nations has criticised UNICEF for what Tehran described as its failure to condemn attacks by the United States and Israel that have killed Iranian children.

heading: China’s Xi urges Middle East to reject foreign influence during rare visit to Egypt
body: Chinese President Xi Jinping has called on Middle East countries to oppose external influence and consider reshaping the region’s security order.

heading: Neither US nor Iran wants war to continue, but are escalating to ‘send the proper message’ to each other
body: Both Iran and the US are escalating to “send the proper message” to one another, Ross Harrison, senior fellow at the Middle East Institute, told Al Jazeera, adding that the US will not be satisfied “until the regime is overthrown”.

heading: Six vessels transited Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday
body: Just six commodity vessels transited the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday, down from 11 the day before, according to the latest ship-tracking data from Kpler, cited by Reuters.

heading: Israeli forces conduct morning detonations in south Lebanon towns
body: Israeli forces have conducted detonations this morning in the towns of Haddatha and Baraachit in southern Lebanon, the National News Agency (NNA) has reported.

heading: Yemen’s armed forces say Houthis fired 14 missiles at western coastal regions
body: We have reported that 10 Houthi ballistic missiles targeted the provinces of Taiz and Hodeidah, according to the military media centre of Yemen’s internationally recognised government.

heading: Gaza sewage system faces ‘unprecedented’ crisis, says water authority
body: Gaza’s sewage system is facing an unprecedented crisis, with about 55,000 cubic metres of untreated wastewater discharged daily, the Palestinian Water Authority has said, according to national broadcaster Palestine TV.

heading: Strait of Hormuz cannot be opened without Tehran’s consent, Iranian security official says
body: Ebrahim Azizi, the chairman of Iran’s parliamentary National Security Commission, said the Strait of Hormuz cannot be opened without Iran’s consent.

heading: Amid Iran attacks on Kuwait, Hormuz traffic drops by half
body: Reporting from Doha, Qatar

heading: WATCH: Education crisis in Lebanon
body: Hundreds of thousands of people have returned to their homes in southern Lebanon after a ceasefire was agreed in June.

heading: Bahrain condemns Iranian attacks on Kuwait
body: Bahrain has condemned repeated Iranian missile and drone attacks on neighbouring Kuwait, describing them as a flagrant violation of Kuwaiti sovereignty and a grave breach of international law and the principles of good neighbourliness.

heading: US official tells Al Jazeera no US bases in the region were hit in last night’s attacks
body: A United States official has told Al Jazeera that US bases in the region “were not subjected to any hits”, including US bases in Kuwait, as Iran launched retaliatory strikes on Wednesday night.

heading: WATCH: Residential building in Kuwait City damaged by Iranian drone
body: An Iranian drone attack has damaged a residential building in Kuwait, authorities say. No casualties have been reported.

heading: French and UK leaders stress need for de-escalation in Strait of Hormuz
body: France and the United Kingdom have discussed the need for “de-escalation in the Strait of Hormuz” during a meeting between UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and French President Emmanuel Macron in London.

body: The Israeli military is potentially planning to carry out attacks on Lebanon on Thursday evening, the Israeli news outlet Channel 7 reports.

heading: Israeli soldiers shoot at two Palestinian children in occupied West Bank
body: Two Palestinian kids have been injured in a shooting by Israeli forces in the town of Beit Fajjar, southern Bethlehem.

heading: Israeli military says it struck northern Gaza in response to fire near Yellow Zone
body: The Israeli military says its forces have struck an area in the northern Gaza Strip, claiming it was responding to fire towards troops operating east of the so-called Yellow Zone.

heading: Israeli athletes removed from Northern Ireland triathlon for attacks on Palestinians
body: Israeli athletes, who were due to compete in an international triathlon in the Northern Irish city of Londonderry this weekend, will no longer be taking part, race organisers have said.
